children.value: > Fact From Story: Messi joined Inter Miami with the club bottom of the Eastern Conference, and the gap was just too big to overcome.
> Fact From Story: Inter Miami have been officially eliminated from the MLS playoff race, with Supporters’ Shield winners FC Cincinnati dealing the deathblow with a 1-0 victory at DRV PNK Stadium.

> > Fact From Story: Messi, who had missed the last four games due to injury, returned to play 35 minutes off the bench, but by the time he stepped on the pitch, Inter Miami’s early dominance in the match had come and gone.
> > > Fact From Story: Messi joined Inter Miami with the club bottom of the Eastern Conference.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: It is difficult to win a soccer match when you do not score any goals.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Injuries can negatively impact a sports team's performance.
> Commonsense Knowledge: It is harder to catch up when you start from behind.
